name: Dichroic
author: E. T. Carter
description: Dichroic glass: the mirror-fold is sampled at a slightly different angle per colour channel, so every reflected edge splits into an oil-slick iridescence — cyan on one flank, magenta on the other. Concentric shard bands swirl through the wedge and the seams flare with colour fringes where they cross, jewel-bright and restless on near-black.

params.label: Iridescence
params.effect: Strength of the per-channel angular split; at 0 the glass is a clean single hue, high pushes a wide prismatic fringe.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation speed of the shard bands through the wedge.

params.label: Shard bands
params.effect: Density of the concentric shard rings — few for broad blades, many for fine slivers.
